purpose: Use the TOPA propaganda-defense manipulation atlas to detect ordinary rhetorical, institutional and social influence mechanisms in sacred and religious texts without equating rhetoric with propaganda or contaminating the preregistered Flood blind experiment.

requirements: at least one named non-manipulative alternative
screening_ladder.claim: Manipulation hypothesis may be tested; intent not established.
Propaganda candidate; deception is not required and effect not established.

requirements: multiple independent context indicators of concealment/coercive asymmetry/systematic distortion/source control
screening_ladder.claim: Manipulative propaganda interpretation supported within historical evidence ceiling.

requirements: S3 or independently supported persuasive program
screening_ladder.claim: Audience effect supported; textual presence or later popularity alone is insufficient.

ancient_text_anachronism_gate.rule: A modern mechanism label may only be used as an analytic analogy when the underlying observable structure exists in the ancient source; modern technological/institutional assumptions must not be imported.
examples: REPETITION_AND_FAMILIARITY may be screened in oral/liturgical material.
BOT_AMPLIFICATION may not be projected onto an ancient corpus.
INFORMATION_LAUNDERING requires an actual traceable intermediary/source chain, not merely multiple manuscripts.
SOCIAL_PROOF may be described from explicit consensus claims, but actual audience consensus requires separate evidence.

base_rate_control_families: contemporary royal inscriptions and victory texts
parallel_run_order: freeze a non-sacred ancient control deck by genre and period
estimate technique base rates in controls
screen sacred passages as S0_FORM_ONLY without intent labels
run reverse pass asking whether the same form is ordinary for genre/period
keep results hidden from Flood A/B coders until their independent coding receipts freeze
after A/B freeze, compare manipulation-screen results to Flood structural results as a separate cross-analysis
